svg.aria-label: Two flowers, of sizes 0.8 and 1.2, drawn from one Flower LOD0 mesh stored once: its stem submesh (FlowerBark) and head submesh (FlowerHead) each have their own indirect command of two instances, both starting at firstInstance 12800, and both commands select the same two 32-byte records, which the generate pass wrote from world cells. The draw runs each command once per record: two stems and two heads make two flowers, the same local shape at two sizes.
